description: TEMPLATE ONLY. OMA-URI custom configuration profile modeled on the Microsoft Graph deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations payload shape. Contains no real tenant values, SSIDs, or endpoints. Validate every OMA-URI in the Intune admin center before production use; production corporate Wi-Fi should be its own Wi-Fi profile type, not a placeholder string.

omaSettings.description: Requires BitLocker encryption on the device. Paired with the compliance policy's bitLockerEnabled check, this both pushes and proves encryption.
Requires startup authentication on system drives (e.g. TPM + PIN where configured), so an encrypted disk still demands an authentication factor at boot.
omaSettings.displayName: BitLocker — require additional authentication at startup

omaSettings.description: Blocks write access to removable storage (USB drives). The practical control against casual data exfiltration to removable media.
omaSettings.displayName: Storage — deny write access to removable disks

omaSettings.description: Turns on Defender real-time protection. Kept enabled alongside cloud protection and tamper protection policy.
Turns on Defender behavior monitoring for file and process behavior heuristics.
Turns on Defender cloud-delivered protection (block at first sight).
PLACEHOLDER. In production this is normally its own Wi-Fi profile type using WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise (EAP-TLS) — never a committed shared PSK. This entry marks where the WLAN profile payload belongs.
